question.text: Portfolio return 17%, risk-free 6%, sigma 5.02%. Sharpe ratio (approx):

explanation.text: The Logic: Sharpe ratio = (portfolio return - risk-free rate) / standard deviation = (17% - 6%) / 5.02% = 11 / 5.02 = 2.19. The Trap: The other values come from incorrect arithmetic in either the excess return or the standard deviation denominator. Note: The workbook uses these exact inputs (17%, 6%, 5.02%) and arrives at 2.19 as a worked example of the Sharpe ratio.
